items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
LEARNED NOTES (observed unless marked guess/uncertain)

CONTROLS: WASD moves; arrow keys fire; movement+fire simultaneously works. Diagonal movement stalls on rocks whose hitboxes exceed sprites—reposition lanes instead of pushing. E drops a bomb at feet (~1s fuse); it damages self; warping away does NOT outrun the fuse. Q/Space do nothing.

TECH X: CONFIRMED again this run—the pill pedestal in the two-poop room auto-granted Tech X ('Laser ring Tears') on entry. It is re-obtainable there; a headband/laser visual attaches. Earlier one run had no pedestal and plain tears, so verify on entry.

LASERS: With Tech X, firing makes a ~1s lingering laser ring at a fixed offset (~0.15-0.2 units) along the firing row/column; rocks block it; alignment matters. The red squiggly ring is my own laser, NOT a lock marker/telegraph (uncertain). Lasers do NOT destroy rocks. In the rock field a rightward laser hit a white-faced chaser (blood visible) but I still lost half a heart; chasers close fast. Lasers are safe only at range with correct row/column aim.

KEYS: Key counter read 01 during this run. KEYHOLE DOOR TESTED AND FAILED earlier: with key 01, adjacent to the rock-field left-wall keyhole (~x0.19-0.20, y~0.46), pressing into it, aligning vertically, and firing left did NOT open it and did NOT consume the key. Whether another action/condition opens it is UNRESOLVED. Red-lidded brown barrels/containers are suspected key-locked (guess).

CHESTS/CONTAINERS: gray chests open by contact. Left-wall gray plates in the TNT room are inert decor (confirmed). Torch-room center gray chest is sealed by indestructible rocks; tested from left/top/right; ABANDON. Dark chest room's two red-lidded unspiked chests (~0.33,0.33 and ~0.67,0.33) do NOT open on contact; approaching the upper-left one cost a heart (likely a chaser). Central spiked chest there is untouchable. Coin pot in the two-poop room breaks on contact for a coin.

BOMBS: Bombing the two-poop room center rock cost a heart and broke nothing—never bomb at low health or adjacent to self. Rocks judged indestructible.

BOMB-WALKER ENEMY (TNT room): a bomb-holding walking enemy at mid-room survived ~5-6 vertical tear volleys with no visible reaction even when nearly column-aligned; shots often drifted off-column. Unclear if armored, offset hitbox, or tears miss; horizontal shots untested. Treat as dangerous; keep distance.

HAZARDS: GREEN GLOWING BLOBS damage on contact, transform (winged/spread/large fast forms), and can expand into large area bursts; a large blob with a spiky rock aura was seen. Green glowing thing near the TNT bottom hatch behaved like a fly/creature, not a collectible—treat as hazard (fairly confident). Rock field is a severe heart drainer; white-faced chasers pursue fast and cluster near hatches/doors; also seen there: small spiky pellets (guess: turret bottom-right), spiked-wheel wall decor, blue-tear shooters, spiked-ring enemy, gray round enemy near top hatch, and a spiky black rock ring with a gray enemy inside at room center. Corner torches damage on touch. Dark chest room: small black creatures/chasers plus black blob/pit shapes at y~0.48; damage cascades there. Standing adjacent to containers while creatures roam is unsafe. HEART DROPS: hearts refilled 1->2 mid-fight in the latest run (partial heal observed; mechanism uncertain, possibly dropped pickups being collected).

DEATH LESSONS: entering enemy rooms without first thinning enemies from the doorway is fatal; at 1 or half a heart any contact ends the run—flee to a hatch rather than fight. Chasers can materialize adjacent and damage lands faster than warps can be set up; do not loiter in the rock field aligning hatches with enemies alive nearby.

HATCH/WARP MECHANICS (re-confirmed many times): warp needs near-exact x-centering plus a sustained walk started ~0.1-0.2 units from the frame. Standing ON the frame blocks warp—back off ~0.15, re-center, then hold; multiple attempts are normal. A long sustained walk (~1.0s) can work after shorter holds fail. In the torch room the top-hatch warp succeeded only after backing off from the frame and holding W ~1.0s; the center column below the top hatch is blocked by rock—route via the left lane up to the top row, then right/up. A rock at ~(0.51,0.32) blocked rightward movement above the rock ring; the top hatch is wide but still needs alignment.

MAP/ROUTES (all hatches confirmed working):
- Tutorial: top hatch x~0.50 <-> rock field; bottom hatch x~0.49-0.50 <-> torch room; right doorway y~0.47 <-> dark chest room.
- Rock field: bottom hatch ~(0.51,0.80) <-> tutorial; top hatch x~0.50 <-> TNT room; keyhole door on left wall ~x0.19-0.20, y~0.44-0.48 (does not open with key 01 contact/shots). This run the top hatch was guarded by a green blob with spiky aura; the bottom hatch route was clear.
- Torch room: top dark hatch x~0.50, y~0.16-0.18 <-> tutorial bottom hatch (bidirectional; entered from tutorial spawning just below it). Gold bottom-center hatch x~0.50, y~0.76-0.79 <-> two-poop room (approach centered from ~0.1-0.15 above). Safe left lane x~0.31-0.42 full height; right lane x~0.63 traversable full height. Center column blocked by rocks below the chest ring.
- Two-poop room: only exit is the top crown/gold hatch x~0.50, y~0.09-0.17 (approach from ~0.1 below; standing on frame blocks). Poop piles regenerate and drop nothing. Tech X pedestal auto-grants on entry; center rock gone in latest visit (earlier vanished; cause unknown, NOT attributable to lasers).
- TNT room: TNT barrels line left wall and mid-room, block movement, inert (don't shoot point-blank); red-lidded brown barrels near left wall; top dark hatch x~0.50, y~0.15 <-> pink-enemy room; bottom hatch <-> rock field.
- Pink-enemy rock room (TNT top hatch): two pink fat enemies left-center; rock wall ring on right with three dark teardrop objects and a small blue creature (uncertain).

UNRESOLVED: keyhole door opening condition; red-lidded chests/barrels; bomb-walker armor/hitbox; heart-refill mechanism; whether the red laser ring has any other meaning (uncertain); two-poop center-rock disappearance cause.
